gen-gf-goldman-gf-pt-sans-caption: Goldman sets its letters wide apart, rounded like open parentheses. PT Sans Caption, a plain sans with big-bodied lowercase and bowls left inviting, keeps paragraphs feeling friendly as the lines pile up.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-questrial: Big, brash energy up front: Grandstander draws plain constant-width lines, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Questrial cuts its plain sans letters flat and open, stencil-like, to match.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-bespoke-sans: Storybook nostalgia with a tall lowercase: Mystery Quest keeps its ascenders compact and leaves every curved stroke open. Mystery Quest does the charming, Bespoke Sans the sharp, refined talking.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-abeezee: Mystery Quest brings bookish, nostalgic charm, its curved strokes open and its compact ascenders sitting above tall lowercase. ABeeZee, a sans-serif like neon glass tubing, keeps its terminals away from the stem.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-aldrich: Bookish and nostalgic, Mystery Quest opens every curve. Aldrich, plain sans cut at a single stroke width with an x-height near the capitals, gives that storybook openness a modern spine.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-amiko: Amiko sets tall lowercase strokes down like a thick crayon mark, terminals pointing outward like a pair of tongs. Mystery Quest brings bookish, nostalgic charm up top while the sans stays modern.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-biryani: Bookish charm, then clarity: Biryani gives every e a clear, large eye and leaves its small counters unclogged. Mystery Quest keeps its jaws open; the sans-serif curves meet the stems exactly.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Nostalgic Mystery Quest keeps ascenders compact and every curved stroke open. Carrois Gothic SC, plain sans, leaves a clear opening at each curve's end, so paragraph after paragraph stays approachable.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-chivo: Lowercase here is packed up near the caps, and every curved opening lets daylight through. Chivo, a sans, backs the bookish Mystery Quest with approachable, professional footing on every line.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-fresca: Fresca reads modern and clean, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Under bookish Mystery Quest, those sans-serif apertures keep counters linked to outside space, so whole paragraphs stay easy going.
